title: Correct final answer (a)
description: Essential: The pin distance for part (a) is correctly stated as 15 cm from the silvered surface.

title: Correct final answer (b)
description: Essential: The shift distance for part (b) is correctly stated as approximately 1.15 cm or 1.16 cm.

title: Effective focal length
description: Important: Correctly calculates the effective focal length of the silvered lens system using the lens maker's formula and mirror formula.

title: Refraction at water interface
description: Important: For part (b), correctly accounts for the apparent shift of the pin's position due to the water layer using the concept of apparent depth.

title: Sign convention application
description: Important: Applies a consistent sign convention for object and image distances and radii of curvature throughout the solution.

title: System equivalence reasoning
description: Optional: Recognizes the system as a combination of a refracting surface and a mirror, and sets up the condition for the image to coincide with the object.

title: Algebraic solving
description: Optional: Shows clear algebraic steps to solve for the unknown object distances in parts (a) and (b).

title: Sign or radius error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the concave radius of curvature (R2 = -60 cm) or for the image distance after refraction.

title: Apparent depth mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies the apparent depth formula (e.g., using real depth over refractive index) when accounting for the water layer in part (b).
